Admission Services

Admission & Registration Office

Welcome to Admission & Registration Office

Ground Floor, Building: 1, BUBT Main Campus

About the Office

The Admission & Registration Office at BUBT manages student admissions, enrollment, and academic registration processes. It ensures accurate record-keeping, smooth course registration, and compliance with university policies to support students throughout their academic journey.
200000+
Students Served
30
Processing Time
13
Staff Members
95%
Accuracy Rate

Services of Our Office

Student Information & Counseling

Provide accurate information about academic programs, admission requirements, tuition fees, and scholarships.

Admission Process Management

Receive and process admission applications and Verify academic documents and eligibility criteria.

Examination & Enrollment Support

• Coordinate with departments for admission tests (if applicable). • Issue student ID numbers and enrollment confirmation.

Financial & Waiver Support

Guide students about admission fees, payment methods, and installment policies.
